messages.text: How many BM1373 chips come in the Harlo B30?

I don't have a confirmed chip count for the B30, so I won't guess one. What I can confirm is 30 TH/s at 405 W, which is about 13.5 J/TH. At 10¢ power that's roughly $29 a month. Should I have our hardware team confirm the chip count?
Yes, I just want to know how many chips.
Handed to the team · Chip count is not in the product facts or the live listing, so it needs confirmi

I've passed the chip count to our hardware team, and they'll get back to you by email at (email hidden) The listing confirms the B30 uses BM1373 chips, but it doesn't say how many.

I also need to correct what I told you earlier. The full spec sheet lists 30 TH/s at 485 W in Turbo mode, which is 16.2 J/TH. That comes to about $35 a month at 10¢ power, not $29.
Before you go, one thing: what are you hoping the chip count will tell you about the B30?
Because I want to know.  It's listed on the magic miner, and the bs-4, and this one doesn't.
That's a fair point. The other two listings show it, so the B30 should too. I've added that to the note for the hardware team. Thanks for the chat, and you'll get the chip count by email.
Cheers.  I just bought a magic miner, and I will mostly likely be getting the bs-4 with the newer chips, but I like the B30 too, so I appreciate the help. :)

Congrats on the Magic M.! One thing that might help you decide: the B30 runs BM1373 chips too, the same newer generation the BitFortun listings name. The BS-4 isn't on sale right now and doesn't have a confirmed drop date yet. The "Notify me" button on its page is the best way to hear first when it goes live. Cheers, and enjoy the 40T.
